source.name: CaliPopGen Dataset 2: Pairwise Population Differentiation
source.version_rule: v1 article/file digest fixed on first discovery; do not silently substitute later versions

target: Within-species pairwise population genetic differentiation Fst; NOT GenDivRange He or TTF original COI transferability

preliminary_filters.metric: exact Fst alias after deterministic normalization
preliminary_filters.site_coordinates: both populations valid lat/lon and error radius <=25km

species_split: SHA256('calipopgen-fst-ttf-fresh-v01|'+lowercase accepted_species_name) fixed parity, all loci/studies of species assigned together
strategy: Comparison of contemporary-climate and geographic predictors vs same plus one historical LGM-to-0BP difference-in-displacement term; group-heldout species; response remains closed until source, support and synthetic calibration gates pass
independence: New source and Fst response; assess publication-level overlap with GenDivRange before treating studies as independent replications. Do not reopen prior TTF-Q, Phase4 or GenDivRange endpoint.
scope_note: California geographic panel, not global generality. Fst magnitude does not by itself identify location of an abrupt genetic break.
